2003 Honda Accord EX K24A4 : Full Obser: The 2003 Accord charging-system circuit explicitly routes alternator L/FR/C information into the ECM/PCM and shows the gauge charging-system indicator driven through the CAN-linked gauge assembly.
That makes 0x224 B6 bit1 a strong charging-system-indicator candidate: it is set KOEO and clear in every running capture, exactly matching the normal battery-light lifecycle.
It is NOT yet fault-confirmed. A high-resolution start capture with the cluster visible can compare the battery lamp, oil lamp, 0x224 B6.1, 0x0D4 B2.7 and RPM clear-times without inducing a fault.
